name: Satozuka Mai
source: She is a friend of the [url=/c83707]protagonist's[/url] younger sister, [url=/c85777]Emiri[/url], and belongs to the doujin circle hosted by her. She often comes to the the protagonist's house to help Emiri with her manuscripts. She is shy, timid and has a low communication skill. She is secretly in love with the protagonist.
